name: Bottle
info:
* A bottle. It's not Mountain Dew.
* (You don't want to talk about it.)
useText:
* You consider drinking from the bottle.
* ...No. Absolutely not.
dropText: * You throw it away. The Underground will remember.

name: Mountain Dew (Warm)
info:
Heals 10 HP.
Tastes like lukewarm regret and citrus.
useText:
* You chugged the warm Mountain Dew.
* You recovered 10 HP! Quickness surged!

name: Stale Doritos
info:
Heals 6 HP.
Nacho Cheese vintage from 2014.
useText:
* You ate the stale Doritos.
* Crunchy yet soggy. You recovered 6 HP!

name: Duct Tape
info:
Reduces FUR by 15.
Rips out unwanted fluff with painful precision.
useText:
* You aggressively taped down your sprouting fur.
* Ouch! FUR reduced by 15!

name: Glitter Pop-Tart
info: * A glittery pastry that restores all HP.
useText: * You sparkle internally. HP maxed out.
notes: Full HP; the current numeric heal field cannot represent a full heal.

name: Commissioned Donut
info: * A donut commissioned from a spider artist.
useText: * ETA: 6-8 weeks. ...It's here already. Somehow.

name: Commissioned Cider
info: * Cider commissioned with extra fluff.
useText: * The artist added extra fluff. To the cider.

name: Snow Cheese Bread
info: * Warm cheese bread made of snow.
useText: * A cheese bread made of snow. Still warm. Brazil.

name: Gamer Fuel 9000
info: * Neon gamer fuel. Restores 30 HP and adds 3 FUR.
useText: * "Now with 400% more neon." You can hear colors.

name: Uwu-mie Flakes
info: * Cheap flakes from Uwu-mie Village.
useText: * Torn-up paper with "uwu" written on it.

name: Cold Water
info: * Cold water from the Hotland water cooler.
useText: * Actual water. You almost forgot what it tastes like.

name: Instant Noodles
info: * Instant noodles from Alphys's lab.
useText: * You eat them raw. Like a true moderator.

name: Questionable Herbal Tea
info: * Questionable tea from the throne.
useText: * You are not sure what herb that was. You feel incredible.

name: Hug Coupon
info: * A coupon worth 10 FLUFF on the Furry route.
useText: * Redeemable for one (1) hug. You redeem it on yourself.

name: Frayed USB Mouse
info:
Weapon (AT 2).
The left click sticks occasionally.
useText: * You equipped the Frayed USB Mouse.

name: Toy Laser Pointer
info: * A dog's worst nightmare. And a wolf's.
useText: * You equipped the Toy Laser Pointer.

name: Fingerless Gloves
info: * Typing at 200 WPM. Cold fingers included.
useText: * You equipped the Fingerless Gloves.

name: Phone Camera
info: * Filming is the deadliest weapon on the surface.
useText: * You equipped the Phone Camera.

name: Real Mechanical Keyboard
info: * Your keyboard. The clack fills you with purpose.
useText: * You equipped the Real Mechanical Keyboard.

name: Your Paws
info: * Soft. Deadly. Mostly soft.
useText: * You equipped Your Paws.

name: One-Sided Broken Headset
info:
Armor (DF 1).
Plays faint anime opening audio in one ear.
useText: * You equipped the One-Sided Broken Headset.

name: Faux-Fur Bandana
info: * So soft. Too soft. It's working on you.
useText: * You equipped the Faux-Fur Bandana.

name: Fursuit Head
info: * It's your size. Why is it your size?
useText: * You equipped the Fursuit Head.

name: Tryhard Headband
info: * Says "NO SCOPE". Smells like a locker.
useText: * You equipped the Tryhard Headband.

name: Pillowcase Cape
info: * A daki cover worn as a cape. Print facing inward. Thankfully.
useText: * You equipped the Pillowcase Cape.

name: Uwu-mie Armor
info: * Makes the game easier. Makes YOU fluffier.
useText: * You equipped the Uwu-mie Armor.
notes: Buy price decreases by 100G per FURRY OVER.

name: Blue-Light Glasses
info: * Filters out cringe. Partially.
useText: * You equipped the Blue-Light Glasses.

name: CELL
info: * A flip phone with paw stickers.
useText: * You open the CELL.

name: Your Old SOUL (Jar)
info: * Your old SOUL, kept in a jar.
useText: * You hold the jar carefully.
notes: Handed to the King on the Furry route.
